changes.rule: synthesis stays only when the request is at least 600 AND the matched static face is below 600: kBoldThreshold (platform/fonts/font_selection_types.h:183) and SkTypeface::isBold (skia src/core/SkTypeface.cpp:491-493), both read at font_cache_skia_win.cc:484-486 (Chromium 0d4dcd4f), the file Windows compiles (platform/BUILD.gn:1810-1813, if (is_win)). The >200 rule rev 14 followed is #if !BUILDFLAG(IS_WIN) (font_cache_skia.cc:312) and never ran on Windows.
changes.cells_changed: 600 over 400 and 700 over 500 now synthesize; 900 over 600 no longer does; 700 over 600 (the zterm case) stays plain
changes.gate: internal/fontspec TestBoldSynthesisFollowsBrowserRule (the Wt450 400/500 family covers the 700/500 cell); green on rev 15, red on rev 14

changes.item: drop shadows clipped out of the border box
changes.files: reference/native/shaders/shadows.rs (vendored copy of the pinned shader, patched)
changes.rule: css-backgrounds-3 section box-shadow: an outer shadow is clipped by the border box; Chromium ClipToBorderEdge (third_party/blink/renderer/core/paint/box_painter_base.cc:165-188 @ 0d4dcd4f). The pinned shader multiplied the element shape in only for inset shadows.
changes.gate: internal/scenespec TestDropShadowClippedOutOfBorderBoxOnRealGPU: a translucent panel (white a=0.5) over a hard red drop shadow reads 127/127 at its center (the plain blend; rev 14 read 255/128/128 - the shadow under the element), while the row below the panel stays pure red

changes.files: GpuiGoSceneBackground (72 bytes: tag, color space, solid, angle, two stops) in quad.background/border_color, shadow.color and path.color; snapshot_color builds the pinned Background through linear_gradient(...).color_space(Srgb)
changes.rule: the vendored common.rs computes the CSS gradient-line length |W*sin| + |H*cos| (css-images-3; Chromium EndPointsFromAngle, core/css/css_gradient_value.cc:1284-1350) and premultiplied sRGB mixing (css-images-4; Chromium platform/graphics/gradient.cc:287). The pinned shader normalized by the dominant axis and mixed straight in a double-encoded space.
changes.gate: internal/scenespec TestGradientBackgroundRecordRoundTrips + TestGradientBackgroundValidationRejectsMalformedRecords (insert, finish, dump, plan; the validation rules)

changes.files: GpuiGoSceneFilterRecord grows filter_tags[4], one composed row-major 4x5 color_matrix and color_matrix_count (188 bytes); the vendored filters.rs composite applies it
changes.rule: filter-effects-1: the CSS colour functions are 4x5 matrices applied to non-premultiplied RGBA; the composite un-premultiplies, maps, clamps and re-premultiplies. A per-pixel linear map commutes with the uniform-per-channel gaussian, so blur-then-matrix is the CSS chain order for any interleaving; consecutive matrices compose into the single payload (caller arithmetic).

changes.files: renderer/draw.rs dx_blur_and_composite + the vendored backdrop_crop pass (native/shaders/filters.rs)
changes.rule: filter-effects-2 clips the backdrop-filter input to the element's border box; Chromium mirrors the edge pixels (SkTileMode::kMirror, components/viz/service/display/skia_renderer.cc:3254 @ 0d4dcd4f). The pinned path blurred the whole current target, so content just outside the element bled in. The crop pass folds out-of-region coordinates back with mirroring and the blurred input is the crop (region plus mirrored margins).
changes.gate: record-level coverage via the filter record gates; the GPU path is exercised by the existing backdrop gates (internal/rendererspec, internal/headlessspec) staying green

changes.item: a point sampler with a per-sprite flag
changes.files: the sprite records' pixelated flag (124/104 bytes), the command record's pixelated flag (56 bytes), the plan's sprite-batch split, GlobalElements.point_sampler
changes.rule: CSS image-rendering: pixelated means nearest-neighbour scaling; the plan splits sprite batches on the flag so one batch draws through one sampler.
changes.gate: internal/scenespec TestPixelatedSpriteFlagSplitsBatches (the plan splits 3 bilinear + 2 pixelated sprites into two commands; the flag round-trips; out-of-range rejected)

changes.files: GpuiGoTextRunRecord 48 -> 92 bytes (word-break, overflow-wrap, text-wrap, locale, font width, variations, optical size, justify); GpuiGoTextVariation; text_shape gains the variation array; the new text_run_info slot (table 224 bytes, 17 pointers)
changes.rule: the fields cross the ABI, validate and round-trip through the stored run records. The pinned TextLayoutRequest/TextRun (crates/gpui/src/text_system.rs:489-519) has no slots and ParleyTextSystem is fully encapsulated, so the shaping behavior is unchanged for them - recorded in TEXT_ABI.md with the exact reason.

changes.files: GpuiMeasureResponse 12 -> 20 bytes (baseline); GpuiGoLayoutRecord 72 -> 80 (the first_baseline echo); GpuiGoLayoutStyleRecord 336 -> 352 (justify-items/self); display tag 4 = flow-root; the new layout_node_set_grid_tracks entry (table 168 bytes) with GpuiGoTrackRecord
changes.rule: the measure baseline is stashed per measured node and echoed (Taffy 0.13's stored Layout drops baselines and its leaf compute hardcodes Point::NONE, compute/leaf.rs:157 - the algorithms keep the pinned fallback; recorded in LAYOUT_ABI.md). Track lists are minmax pairs (length/min-content/max-content/auto/fr). justify-items/self map onto Taffy's fields; flow-root is Display::FlowRoot.
changes.gate: internal/layoutspec TestFlowRootDisplayLaysOut, TestGridTrackListLaysOut (240px + 1fr at 400px), TestJustifyItemsAndSelfAreAccepted, TestMeasureResponseBaselineEchoes

vendored_shaders.what: reference/native/shaders holds vendored, patched copies of the pinned gpui_render shader modules (common, corner_smoothing, quads, shadows, filters, a minimal interface), compiled by reference/native/build.rs through the pinned crate's own chain: wgsl-rs -> Naga 24 (HLSL sm_5.0) -> D3DCompile (Fxc). The frozen ce-source stays unmodified.
vendored_shaders.pipelines: quads, smoothed_quads, shadows, smoothed_shadows, blur_composite, smoothed_blur_composite, backdrop_crop (DXBC in OUT_DIR, include_bytes! into the artifact)
vendored_shaders.build_dependencies: naga 24.0.0 (hlsl-out, wgsl-in), wgsl-rs (the pinned rev), windows (Fxc) - the same versions the pinned gpui-render dependency already resolves; host-only, no runtime imports

cargo_test: cargo test -p gpui-go-native still fails to compile the lib test target with the same 5 pre-existing a11y/capture errors (a11y.rs:1361/1367/1385 - the missing accesskit::ActionHandler trait import; capture.rs:1510/1531 - ID3D11Texture2D::default() which windows 0.62.2 does not provide, and two unsafe calls outside unsafe blocks). Nothing new: the rev-15 record changes' test constructors were updated and the test target now fails only on those five. The behavior is verified through the Go gates against this artifact.

One environment note: fx-0004's text-geometry trace records fontFamilyCount 94 (captured 2026-10-05); this machine now enumerates 95 system families, so that one gate reports a count mismatch - a machine font-set drift since the recording, not a rev-15 change (no code path in this rebuild touches catalog enumeration; the run before this ticket would see the same).
